goal_features.statement: Flexible advanced computing coursework and a capstone support preparation for applied computing careers; no placement outcome is promised.

fact_summary: The Brooklyn on-campus MSCS requires 30 credits, including a capstone. Entry preparation includes science, calculus, programming and computer fundamentals; duration/equivalency remain manual.
